<a id="global-support-of-coded-joint-plans--代码共同方案的全局支持"></a>
# Global support of coded joint plans

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`code-plan-global-support` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F02 · [record](code-plan-global-support.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A plan realized at a description is supported at every configuration it describes where configurations the description identifies match parts into configurations it identifies, the leaves are read correctly through it, and footprints are within and apart.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A configuration's footprint supports a list where the list repeats nothing and each member lies within the footprint; footprints are within where each part a whole holds has its footprint within the whole's, and apart where the two parts a whole holds share nothing of their footprints. What a plan's leaves draw on is joined leaf by leaf, in order. (`Becoming.Supports`, `Becoming.PartsWithin`, `Becoming.PartsApart`, `Becoming.JointPlan.draws`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. For any ternary joint relation, footprint and description: where configurations the description identifies match parts into ones it identifies, footprints are within and apart, and leaves are read through the description exactly as support, a plan realized at a configuration's description, under the joint relation read through it, has what its leaves draw on supported by that configuration's footprint. (`Becoming.JointPlan.supports_of_image`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. In a joint frame, through a code reading the joint tests exactly and giving one code to configurations passing the same ones: where the pairs of parts held are compact for the joint tests, each joint test holds wherever it cannot fail, footprints are within and apart, and leaves are read through the code exactly as support, a plan realized at a configuration's code has its leaves' draws supported by its footprint. (`Becoming.JointPlan.supports_of_code`, `Becoming.JointFrame.JointCompact`, `Becoming.JointFrame.TestsStable`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. Support at the root need not give realization, in a witness: where no whole holds any part, the footprint of the one configuration supports what a plan of two empty leaves draws on, and the plan is not realized. (`Becoming.Unjoined.supports_not_realizes`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Description form: any ternary joint relation on configurations of any kind, any footprint and any description; matching of parts through the description (MatchesParts), footprints of parts within the whole's (PartsWithin) and apart (PartsApart), and leaves read correctly as support (Supports).
- Code form: a joint frame of the spine and a code of its joint tests, with JointCompact, TestsStable, Exact and Reduced, which give the matching of parts through the code, and PartsWithin, PartsApart and leaves read correctly as support.
- Plans are finite binary nestings.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Support is shown where the two parts a whole holds have footprints apart; where their footprints overlap it is not shown.
- Support at the root does not give realization: the converse needs conditions beyond footprints within and apart. Witness: `Becoming.Unjoined.supports_not_realizes`.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

<a id="next--下一步"></a>
## Next

State what a realized plan's leaves draw on where the parts' footprints overlap, counted with its repetitions, and find the conditions under which support at the root gives realization.
